stations.title: Old program
stations.text: Met one bad line and sent nothing

stations.title: Harbour office
stations.say: The whole day, the bad line named.

captions: Closing time at Lanternquay. The harbour office wants the day's sailings from the till.
One line of the file says thirty, and the old program falls over and sends nothing.
You read each line into a record, set bad lines aside by number, and write the report.
Now every good sailing is counted and summed, and the bad line is named for a fix.
The office gets its report every evening, to the penny, whatever the till writes.
